assets.name: neon-recess
assets.prompt: Create one original flat print-ready surface pattern for Keepsake phone cases, called Neon Recess (do not write the name). Style: 1990s Memphis neon doodle pattern. Portrait 1:2 proportion. Solid pure black background. Dense but airy scatter of small hand-drawn smooth neon cyan, mint green, hot pink, lavender squiggles, tiny outline rings, open triangles, zigzag strokes, little dashes and dots, with consistent rounded line weight and balanced sizes. Shapes occupy about 25 percent of the surface, black negative space 75 percent. Sophisticated playful screen-print look, crisp flat solid colors, no glow blur or gradients. Pattern reaches all edges and remains balanced when cropped to phone cases. This is the artwork only: no phone, camera hole, product mockup, border, text, logos, watermark or lighting. Make a fresh original arrangement.

assets.name: arcade-after-dark
